title: 🍽️ Multiple Food & Hospitality Jobs in Delaware County, PA - NewsBreak
text:
20 hours ago Delaware County’s food and hospitality scene is buzzing this season, with local venues adding friendly, service‑minded folks to their teams. Whether you like the energy of events or the calm of a care center kitchen, there’s something here for you.
Dietary Aide (Part‑Time, Every Other Weekend) Employer: Sterling Healthcare and Rehabilitation Center
Location: Media, PA
Type: Part‑Time
Join a caring team at a 164‑bed long‑term care facility . You’ll help prepare and serve meals that meet residents’ needs while keeping the kitchen safe and sanitary. Experience in long‑term care is required.
Bartender – Terrain Events Employer: Free People (URBN)
Location: Glen Mills, PA
Type: Part‑Time
Pay: Starting from $18/hr
Mix garden‑inspired cocktails at beautiful event spaces. Ideal for experienced bartenders who love fast‑paced, creative settings. Must have RAMP certification and weekend availability.
Night Auditor – The Brandywine Radnor, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel Employer: Aimbridge Hospitality
Location: Wayne, PA
Type: Full‑Time
Perfect for night owls who enjoy both hospitality and numbers. Handle guest check‑ins, balance the books, and keep the property secure overnight. Full‑time staff get medical, dental, vision, PTO, and 401(k) benefits.
If you’re ready to serve up great experiences, check out these openings and apply soon—Delco’s hospitality teams are growing fast!
